about: A small known-item retrieval set for search by meaning over email. Fictional people, .example domains. Queries are written the way someone remembers a message, mostly without its words (paraphrase), plus cross-language and exact-identifier queries. 'relevant' lists every message that answers the query. Used by tests/real_model.rs and examples/eval.rs; results in docs/SEMANTIC.md. Messages marked distractor are near-topic hard negatives (same vocabulary or domain, wrong answer).
